summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test for ShowUp.ai v1. 19/19 pytest backend tests pass (auth, webinar create + 8-touch auto-create + lead-magnet doc, registrants with cross-source dedupe, Circle webhook, bulk import, attendance patch, settings persistence, approval queue enrichment, touch approval, analytics overview, AI lead-magnets populated within 100s, varied touch angles). Frontend Playwright run verified login, dashboard with seeded webinar, New Webinar dialog -> create -> detail page with 3 tabs and 8 touch-cards, lead-magnets warning banner, Approval Queue (16 pending cards, banner present), Settings (all 12 API key fields + 8 touch rows + save), Analytics (all 3 chart/table testids), Public Register success state, and Logout redirect.

issues: lm-section-case-study/snippets/one-pager only render after AI content arrives (~30-60s). During wait only the spinner+banner are shown. This is expected v1 UX but means those testids are not visible immediately after webinar creation. The warning banner (lm-warning) is correctly visible at all times.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 618 lines - approaching the 700 line soft limit. Consider splitting into modules (auth, webinars, registrants, touches, analytics, ai_generators) before more features are added.

Background AI generation (_bg_generate_all) runs touches sequentially via Claude (8 round trips). For better UX consider asyncio.gather across touches; currently touches can take 60-180s to fully populate.
Public POST /api/webinars/{wid}/register has no rate limiting - could be abused to flood registrants. Acceptable for v1 but flag for v2.
Circle webhook accepts raw Dict[str, Any] - no Pydantic schema. Works but loses validation. Consider a CircleWebhookIn model.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated in FastAPI in favour of lifespan handlers - works for now but will warn on newer FastAPI versions.
scheduler tick marks touches sent without doing real third-party deliveries (per v1 mock note). Add structured log so devs spot this in production.
seed_data_creation: Test created several TEST_-prefixed registrants and one TEST_Webinar_PyTest webinar (auto-deleted in fixture teardown). UI test left one extra 'UI Test Webinar' + 'uitest_reg@example.com' registrant on the seeded user's account - main agent may want to clean these.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and require domains valid per EmailStr (use example.com, NOT .test or .local). Background AI generation can take 60-180s; the lead-magnets AI test waits up to 100s and the touch-angles test up to 150s. The lead-magnet tab UI only renders lm-section-* once ai_content.case_study is non-empty - not a bug.
